title: Apple unveils new 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 chip

claims.claim: Apple unveiled its new 14-inch MacBook Pro powered by its latest M6 chip on Tuesday.

evidence.quote: Apple on Tuesday unveiled its new 14-inch MacBook Pro, powered by its latest M6 chip.

claims.claim: The new MacBook Pro has 24 hours of battery life and supports Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6 connectivity.

evidence.quote: The new MacBook Pro has 24 hours of battery life and now supports for Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6 connectivity.

claims.claim: The new 14-inch MacBook Pro starts at $1,999 and is available in space black and silver.

evidence.quote: The laptop starts at $1,999 and is available in space black and silver.

claims.claim: Apple announced its new iPad mini on Monday.

evidence.quote: On Monday, Apple announced its new iPad mini.

claims.claim: The M6 chip features a 12-core CPU and a 12-core GPU delivering up to 30% faster graphics and up to 25% faster AI workloads compared with the M5 chip.

evidence.quote: The tech giant says the M6 chip features a 12-core CPU with the world’s fastest CPU core and a 12-core GPU that delivers more responsive performance, up to 30% faster graphics, and up to 25% faster AI workloads compared with the M5 chip.

claims.claim: The new iMac starts at $1,499 and comes in blue, green, pink, yellow, purple, orange, and silver.

evidence.quote: The new iMac starts at $1,499 and comes in blue, green, pink, yellow, purple, orange, and silver.

claims.claim: The new iMac features a 24-inch 4.5K Retina display and runs on macOS 27.

evidence.quote: It features a 24-inch 4.5K Retina display, an advanced camera and audio system, up to four Thunderbolt 4 ports, color-matched accessories, and macOS 27.

claims.claim: Both the new MacBook Pro and iMac can be preordered starting October 28 and will be available starting November 6.

evidence.quote: Both the new MacBook Pro and iMac can be preordered starting October 28 and will be available starting November 6.
